name: Simulation Baseball
summary:
Simulation Baseball is a browser-native baseball franchise simulation with the depth of a desktop front-office game. Take control of your favorite franchise as General Manager and Manager: scout amateurs, run the draft, work trades and free agency, build a farm system, set your lineups and rotation, and watch a purpose-built engine play out every game pitch by pitch into full box scores, statistics, and standings.

Play solo against AI front offices, or run an online league with up to 30 human managers, with AI filling any open seats. The simulation weighs hundreds of performance factors, real player development and aging, and a deep morale and personality system, all grounded in real Major League data.
